channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran claims to have captured a US ‘sail drone’ near Hormuz Strait
item.description: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard says its navy struck a US-operated surface drone at the entrance of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran war live: IRGC attacks US unmanned vessel in Hormuz; two ships hit
item.description: IRGC says it attacked a US unmanned vessel in Hormuz, while UKMTO says projectiles hit two ships off Oman.

item.title: UN envoy warns Security Council Yemen’s war has entered ‘dangerous phase’
item.description: Envoy for Yemen Hans Grundberg demands urgent steps to protect civilians and trade routes amid Houthi escalation.

item.title: Israel says it destroyed Hezbollah base in Lebanon’s Ali al-Taher ridge
item.description: Israeli attacks come a week after it said to have established operational control over the strategic ridge.

item.title: Israel says it destroyed key Hezbollah tunnels in southern Lebanon
item.description: Israel’s military says it has destroyed a network of Hezbollah tunnels on the strategic Ali al-Taher ridge in Lebanon.

item.title: Russian strike hits shopping centre in central Ukraine
item.description: A Russian strike on a shopping centre in the central Ukrainian city of Pavlohrad killed at least four people.

item.title: What’s happening in Yemen and how did we get here?
item.description: Fighting has reignited in Yemen as Houthi forces push south towards the strategic Bab al-Mandab Strait.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
item.description: Mokha's capture would bring the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait waterway, a key shipping route.

item.title: Israel's Netanyahu to sue newspaper over claim UAE warned him of 7 October attack
item.description: The paper said it stood by its reporting, after publishing extracts from a book where the claim appears.

item.title: More than 20 children killed in DR Congo school fire
item.description: Officials say there was a stampede as they fled a fire that engulfed two schools in the eastern rebel-held city of Bukavu.
